source_title: Greenberg Traurig Latin America Attorneys, Practices Recognized in The Legal 500 Latin America 2027 Edition
source_excerpt:
MIAMI and MEXICO CITY, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- More than 60 attorneys from global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP are recognized in The Legal 500 Latin America 2027 Edition . Additionally, the firm is recognized as a Top Tier Firm in five areas and 15 of the firm's practices are recognized in Mexico and Latin America: International Firms.
The Legal 500 Latin America 2027 rankings reflect months of extensive research across 19 jurisdictions, drawing on more than 7,500 law firm submissions, feedback from nearly 90,000 referees, and thousands of interviews with general counsel and private practice lawyers throughout the region.
The firm also is one of a select few firms that received the Client Satisfaction accolade, recognizing exceptionally high scores for client service and client experience in The Legal 500 's annual survey of hundreds of thousands of clients worldwide. The Legal 500 recognized Greenberg Traurig as the only firm in Mexico to receive top scores across all four criteria: Lawyer & Team Quality, Billing & Efficiency, Sector Knowledge, and Net Promoter Score.
